Year 4 times tables practice

The recall focus includes 6 times table, 7 times table, 9 times table, 11 times table, 12 times table, 3 times table, 4 times table, 8 times table, 2 times table, 5 times table, 10 times table, 1 times table. Children practise multiplication and related division facts, with later review used to check recall.

6 times table7 times table9 times table11 times table12 times table3 times table4 times table8 times table2 times table5 times table10 times table1 times table

Use the game alongside practical maths.

Talk through answers, use counters or drawings, and practise measuring, shape and other hands-on tasks away from the screen. The parent report includes practical checks; in-game scores do not replace a teacher’s assessment.

Frequently asked questions

Is this suitable for a Year 4 pupil who finds maths difficult?

Yes. Choose the child’s practice year, let the warm-up check their starting point and use Coach’s worked steps when needed. Earlier supporting skills can be revisited without changing their school year.

Can a parent see Year 4 progress?

Open the Parent report in the game to see topic evidence, example questions, areas needing support and the checklist for a skill becoming secure.
